result.content: With 300 skilled archers participating, this championship marked the largest gathering in the history of whistling archery. As the competition kicked off, teams sang uplifting archery songs and performed the "Gongbu Arrow Dance", setting an enthusiastic tone for the day. When an archer hit the target, teammates celebrated with high-fives and cheers of "Chaxiu!" to encourage one another.
